title: 第20章 仙佩第21章 进玉佩
slug: 凡人修仙我只是个路人甲
content_zh:
“各位客人稍安勿躁，我们之所以停在这里不走，是因为我们有一位客人如厕未归。
初步判断他可能被人弄晕绑走了，我们正在搜寻他的下落，还请各位客人留在自己马车上，不要随意走动。
大家放心，只要老实待在马车上，我们的镖师是绝对保护大家的安全，大家不要担心。”
镖头果断把事实告知大家，若是一直瞒着不说，客人闹起来更是添乱。
客人们听见镖头说的内容，霎时安静下来了，不敢再闹事，生怕下一个被绑走的就是自己。
各个回到自己马车，也不好奇了，变成了一个个鹌鹑。
林鹤清也开始冷静下来思考，为什么歹人要绑走一个身上看起来不会有半分钱的人，而且还是趁人在上厕所的时候。
除非，歹人认识方有为，认为方有为一定把银票或者某样东西放在身上了。
这样东西应该就是方有为一直和他们混住的原因了。
如果东西在方有为身上，被搜走了的话，要么明天见到他，要么明天看到他的尸体。
林鹤清按耐住了自己的好奇心，毕竟方有为还没死，这东西还是有主的，偷东西不好。
毕竟，这个东西的存在是大家都知道的，而且很有可能就是造成忠义镖局损失过半的原因。
是的，林鹤清一直觉得奇怪，明明忠义镖局的镖师几乎全部失去战斗力，为什么不顺手把装满货物的马车直接劫走，反而只失去了部分商品。
看来，应该是那些人应该是有目标的，方有为用了障眼法，用了个假物件把人引走了，却没想到歹人这么快就发现东西不对，把他给绑了。
大家在原地等待，镖头说如果明天他们仍然找不到方有为，就只能启程了，毕竟他们已经尽力了。
但是如果东西不在他身上，那么能在哪呢？
这么重要的东西方有为一定不会放在离他很远的地方，那就只能是在林鹤清自己的马车上了。
当晚，马车上林鹤清和齐爷爷在睡觉的时候，拿被子出来的时候，林鹤清好像在方有为被子里摸到什么硬硬的东西，摸起来有一掌之握。
林鹤清知道，这个就是方有为一直藏着的东西了。
他没有轻举妄动，放在原来的位置最安全，除非明天出现新的事故，他不会做什么事，毕竟他修仙才是一等一的大事。

普通人要想修仙真是太难了，林鹤清有了清灵界想修仙也不是简单的事，还得自己找修仙的机缘。
第二天凌晨，林鹤清感觉应该是五点左右的样子，突然有许多马蹄声由远及近，马蹄声急促。
林鹤清猛然惊醒，把齐爷爷轻轻摇醒，自己迅速穿好衣服，齐大夫还在穿衣服的时候，有一个很大的声音传来。
“交出仙佩，否则别想离开”，一个大汉大声喊道，随后他们的马匹把车队团团围住。
“各位好汉，我们兴隆镖局在南丰国北丰国也是名声响当当的镖局，有什么事情大家都好商量。”胡镖头的声音紧随其后，他骑马从前头出来。
“这个，你们认识吗？”一个大汉举起一个软塌塌的人，那人脑袋低垂，身上破破烂烂的，似有血迹。
林鹤清一眼看出那个人正是方有为。
“此人正是我们镖队救下的客人，你们为什么要绑架他，快把他放了。”
“这个人偷了我们的东西，我们要把东西拿回来。放了？好，这就放了”，随后那大汉把方有为往地上一丢。
方有为掉在地上，头朝下，不知道是不是已经死了，“哈哈哈哈哈哈”。
content_en:
"Dear guests, please be patient. The reason why we stopped here is because one of our guests did not return from the toilet.
Preliminary judgment is that he may have been knocked unconscious and kidnapped. We are searching for his whereabouts. We also ask all guests to stay in their carriages and not to move around at will.
Don't worry, everyone, as long as you stay on the carriage, our escorts will absolutely protect everyone's safety, so don't worry. "
The head escort decisively told everyone the facts. If he kept it secret, the guests would make trouble even more.
When the guests heard what the escort chief said, they immediately became quiet and did not dare to cause trouble again, for fear that they would be the next kidnapped.
Everyone returned to their carriages, no longer curious, and turned into quails.
Lin Heqing also began to calm down and think about why the gangster kidnapped a person who didn't seem to have any money on him, and also took advantage of him while he was using the toilet.
Unless the bad guy knows Fang Youwei and thinks that Fang Youwei must have put the banknote or something on his person.
This kind of thing should be the reason why Fang Youwei has been living with them.
If the things were on Fang Youwei and were searched, you would either see him tomorrow or see his body tomorrow.
Lin Heqing suppressed his curiosity. After all, Fang Youwei was not dead yet. There was still an owner of this thing. It was not good to steal things.
After all, everyone knows about the existence of this thing, and it is likely to be the reason for more than half of the losses of Zhongyi Escort Bureau.
Yes, Lin Heqing has always found it strange that almost all the escorts of the Zhongyi Escort Bureau had lost their combat effectiveness. Why didn't they just hijack the carriage full of goods and only lose part of the goods?
It seems that those people must have a target. Fang Youwei used a deception trick and used a fake object to lure people away. However, he did not expect that the villain would find something wrong so quickly and tie him up.
Everyone was waiting in place, and the escort leader said that if they still couldn't find Fang Youwei tomorrow, they would have no choice but to set off. After all, they had tried their best.
But if it wasn't on him, where could it be?
Such an important Dongxi Youwei would not be placed far away from him, so it could only be on Lin Heqing's own carriage.
That night, when Lin Heqing and Grandpa Qi were sleeping in the carriage, when they took out the quilt, Lin Heqing seemed to touch something hard under Fang Youwei's quilt, which felt like a palm.
Lin Heqing knew that this was what Fang Youwei had been hiding.
He did not act rashly. It was safest to put it in its original position. Unless there was a new accident tomorrow, he would not do anything. After all, his cultivation of immortality was a first-class matter.
It is really difficult for ordinary people to cultivate immortality. It is not easy for Lin Heqing to cultivate immortality when he has the Qingling Realm. He has to find the opportunity to cultivate immortality on his own.
In the early morning of the next day, Lin Heqing felt that it should be around five o'clock. Suddenly there were many horse hoofbeats coming from far and near, and the sound of horse hoofbeats was rapid.
Lin Heqing woke up suddenly, shook Grandpa Qi awake gently, and quickly got dressed. While Doctor Qi was still getting dressed, there was a loud sound.
"Hand over the Xianpei, or you won't be able to leave," a big man shouted, before their horses surrounded the convoy.
"Everyone, our Xinglong Escort Bureau is also a well-known escort bureau in Nanfeng and Beifeng Kingdoms. We can all discuss anything." The voice of Mr. Hu followed closely, and he rode out from the front.
"Do you know this?" A big man held up a limp man. The man's head was drooped and his body was in tatters and seemed to be stained with blood.
Lin Heqing saw at a glance that the person was Fang Youwei.
"This person is the guest who was rescued by our escort team. Why did you kidnap him? Let him go quickly."
"This man stole our things, and we have to get them back. Let him go? Okay, let him go now." Then the big man threw Fang Youwei to the ground.Throw it away.
Fang Youwei fell to the ground, head down, wondering if he was dead, "Hahahahahaha".
